_comment: The kinds of file a project of this core holds; Chimera's New Project window is built from it. A max of -1 means no limit. The driver reads the slots in this order (waterbox/np2-driver.c).

slots.title: Floppy disks
slots.help: Floppy disk images (.d88, .fdi, .hdm, .nfd, .dcp, .fdd, .hd4 and the other PC-98 formats). The first is in drive 1 and the second in drive 2 when the machine starts. The order here is the order the Previous, Next and Swap Floppy Disk inputs go through. What the machine writes to a disk stays for the session and can be exported as save data.

slots.title: Hard disks
slots.help: Hard disk images (.hdi, .nhd, .thd, .vhd or SL9821's .slh). The first is the first hard disk (IDE on the PC9821 machine, SASI on the PC98 one), the one the machine starts from when no floppy is in drive 1. What the machine writes stays for the session and can be exported as save data, and an exported image can be given here to continue from it.

slots.title: SCSI hard disks
slots.help: Hard disks on a PC-9801-55 SCSI board, which the machine gets when this list has a disk: Virtual98 .hdd, RaSCSI .hdn and .hds, or .hdi, .nhd and .vhd. The first is SCSI ID 0, the next ID 1 and so on. The machine starts from the first SCSI disk when no floppy is in a drive and there is no IDE or SASI hard disk. What the machine writes stays for the session and can be exported as save data.

slots.title: CD-ROMs
slots.help: CD-ROM images for the IDE CD-ROM drive, which only the PC9821 machine has: a .cue sheet with its track files (one .bin for the whole disc or one per track), an .iso, or a MAME .chd (made with chdman createcd). The first is in the drive when the machine starts; the CD Previous, Next, Swap and Eject Disc inputs change it, in the order listed here. A CloneCD .ccd can be converted to .cue and .bin first. A PC-98 cannot start from a CD, so a CD game also needs its boot floppy or a hard disk with its driver.
